tables.name: intel_graph.import_runs
tables.purpose: Audit each source polling, file import, or agent import execution.

tables.name: intel_graph.graph_patches
tables.purpose: Store dry-run/apply graph mutation envelopes before touching canonical graph objects.

tables.name: intel_graph.sources
tables.purpose: Track publishers, feeds, libraries, people, APIs, and other intake sources.
tables.identity: stable configured or provider source id

tables.name: intel_graph.works
tables.purpose: Track articles, books, papers, posts, videos, podcast episodes, repositories, documents, and notes.
tables.identity: stable work id with source_id and url uniqueness

tables.name: intel_graph.work_segments
tables.purpose: Track chapters, paragraphs, transcript spans, quoted ranges, and durable excerpt anchors.

tables.name: intel_graph.intake_events
tables.purpose: Track discovered, opened, read, saved, dismissed, queued, cited, and annotated events.

tables.name: intel_graph.annotations
tables.purpose: Track notes, highlights, questions, summaries, quotes, and comments against works or segments.

tables.name: intel_graph.entities
tables.purpose: Track people, organizations, places, products, repositories, concepts, and other named entities.
tables.identity: stable entity id plus aliases and identifiers

tables.name: intel_graph.topics
tables.purpose: Track controlled and emergent topics for retrieval, curation, and explanation.
tables.identity: stable topic id with optional parent topic

tables.name: intel_graph.claims
tables.purpose: Track source claims with provenance, stance, confidence, and source/segment anchors.

tables.name: intel_graph.work_entities
tables.purpose: Connect works or segments to mentioned entities.

tables.name: intel_graph.work_topics
tables.purpose: Connect works or segments to topics.

tables.name: intel_graph.source_assessments
tables.purpose: Track user-owned quality, reliability, noise, coverage, and trust assessments.

tables.name: intel_graph.relevance_scores
tables.purpose: Store advisory scoring outputs with reasons, evidence, missing evidence, and deterministic tie breakers.

tables.name: intel_graph.project_connections
tables.purpose: Connect intel to projects, writing, resumes, job searches, and other LifeDB domains.

tables.name: intel_graph.life_graph_mappings
tables.purpose: Map selected intel records into curated public.life_graph_objects only when promotion is warranted.

promotion_rules: Raw intake remains in intel_graph by default.
Saved, cited, annotated, or project-linked intel can be proposed for public.life_graph_objects.
Projected sites must read curated Life Graph projections, not raw intel tables.
Agent-generated relevance and claims are advisory until a separate graph patch or user action applies them.
